result:
The raid HUD is better, but no screen has reached 4 from the critic yet.

The only screen I could score in this run was 50 (the live arcade HUD). It is at 3 and the critic says it is better than before. That was on the v31.17 build, which had a stamina-label bug I fixed afterwards in v31.21 (below). I did not re-run the critic on v31.21. Screen 21 (the calm raid HUD) had a critic run that was cut off, so I don't have its score. The other 13 screens in your list (19, 20, 22–24, 33, 34, 36, 37, 48, 51, 61, 78) have after pictures but have never been through the critic, so their scores are still unknown.

What shipped this run, all through the gate with the seed-4242 fingerprint unchanged:
- **v30.93:** the left feed drops detail text over four words and dims when idle.
- **v30.96:** the score and clock sit on a plate.
- **v31.03:** HUD panels are a flat fill with a lighter 1px edge, and the demo gun card is shorter (58 high).
- **v31.17 and v31.21:** the hp, armour and stamina bars are now one width. v31.17 widened them to 360 and the critic caught the stamina word running into belt slot 1, so v31.21 narrowed all three to 300.

Earlier runs already shipped your numbers: run info shows at most 3 contracts (Q1), the demo hides credits, XP, stash, bag, item value and the backpack hint (Q55, Q56), and ammo is the biggest number on the gun card (Q57).

Still open, all P1:
- **Run info title:** "run info" and "run goals" are two stacked titles. The old check 27.42 needs the "run goals" heading, so the "run info" title is the one to drop.
- **Score block:** it sits flush against the top edge, and the "extract" line is outside its plate.
- **Ammo panel:** it is translucent. Old checks find the gun card by its 0.62 alpha, so raising it means retargeting them.
- **Hotbar:** two slots look highlighted at once.
- **Posture chip:** "standing" is still a boxed chip.
- **Minimap:** it sits 15px from the edge, and an old check asserts that exact margin.

I skipped the critic's 96px margin requests. The style guide says the HUD may cross the 5% margin, so that advice doesn't apply to it.

Notes with the full list are in `notes/02-raid-hud-redesign.md`. The picture pairs are in `notes/shots/02-before` and `02-after8`, and the change is logged in `notes/ui/changes.md`.

TASK PARTIAL: screen 50 is at 3, screen 21 is unknown, and the other 13 screens have not been scored. The open P1s above are still to do (run info title, score block, ammo panel fill, hotbar highlight, posture chip, minimap margin).
